answer: Propose stake-weighted dispatch: each ID locks at least 10 tokens for a day; no token backs two IDs. Award one garden route-planning job/day by stake weight, not ID count. Validators check locks and endpoints and reject any vertex in a flooded hollow. Late or invalid plans burn 10 tokens and earn nothing. Shared servers or parallel bids cannot duplicate weight. Hardware is reusable; power recurs; unslashed stake returns. Borrowed stake qualifies; ownership is not proved. Ten IDs lock 10 x 10 = 100 tokens for the same aggregate odds as one ID locking 100.
